About the Venue

Canal Road par aik pur-sukoon event jagah

Canal Orchid Event Complex 74 G2, Main Canal Road, M.A. Johar Town, Lahore par waqeh hai — Canal Road ki asaan rasai ke sath, Johar Town aur aas paas ke ilaqon ke liye aik convenient location.

Venue weddings aur corporate functions host karta hai, aur is ki capacity 100 se 700 guests tak hai — chhoti family gathering se lekar bare baraat aur walima events tak ke liye mozon.

Public reviews me venue ko 4.2 rating (567 reviews) mili hui hai. Date ki availability aur event ki tafseel ke liye venue se direct rabta karain ya neeche WhatsApp par poochain.

Venue Ko Call Karain — 0321 4733775
